articles.summary: As part of the DoW’s acquisition transformation, streamlined processes must be extended to all companies in the defense industrial base. Breaking Defense discussed with Sam Mehta, President, Space & Mission Systems and Communications & Spectrum Dominance, L3Harris.

articles.summary: L3Harris Technologies has played a critical role in NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope mission, designing and building the optical telescope assembly that serves as Roman's optical eye.
articles.title: Roman Space Telescope Will Survey a Century of Cosmos in Weeks: L3Harris Technology Makes It Possible

articles.summary: Full scale testing of L3Harris’ high energy, lower cost solid-fueled ramjet advances propulsion that gives warfighters greater stand off range, faster engagement timelines and decisive overmatch against high speed threats.
articles.title: L3Harris Advances Solid-Fueled Ramjet Propulsion for Greater Reach and Faster Effects

articles.summary: L3Harris Technologies has opened a new 50,000-square-foot maritime production facility at ProvPort in Providence, marking the completion of a $6 million investment to design, produce and deliver advanced undersea training systems for the U.S. Navy and allied forces.
articles.title: L3Harris Opens Rhode Island Production Facility to Support US and Allied Naval Readiness

articles.title: L3Harris Achieves Historic First Flight Success with Perimeter Truss Reflector Technology

articles.title: L3Harris to Present at Upcoming Investor Conference

L3Harris conducted the test as part of the Lockheed Martin team advancing the effort to strengthen the nation’s homeland missile defense.
